input: 19 accepted prototype/schema V2, saved-only reviewer inspection; no DB write/read query

issues.evidence: prototype.py setup_db() unlinks existing media_pilot.sqlite before rebuild
issues.required: New execution stores persistent real pilot data; additive/idempotent writes, transactional failure rollback, no default deletion/rebuild that discards earlier article/version/request evidence.

issues.evidence: PILOT_SCOPE max_body_checks_per_source_month=1 vs5 slots per cell
issues.required: Only new20 scope allows5 body checks/cell, total150; old scope and slots retain exact bytes/history; partial enumeration not monthly census.

issues.evidence: sample_slot and frame_membership accept any existing parent FK; no source/edition agreement with frame.source_era
issues.required: Guard insert and update of slot/frame-membership/era linkage so a parent from another outlet/edition cannot fill a frame; actual month eligibility separately validated from publication date evidence.

issues.evidence: provenance_assertion.parent_id and version_id are independent FKs; article_version parent can disagree
issues.required: Reject parent/version disagreement for insert/update when version supplied; date/conflicting provenance should remain unknown/conflict, not coerced.

issues.evidence: V2 parse_article returns only count/status and initial build_pilot unconditionally new_full_bodies=0
issues.required: Only when actually acquired, store exact extracted body/hash with raw-to-version evidence; previews/challenges/multi-Article mismatches not certified full body. Structural presence is not completeness; avoid phantom actual counts.

verification_style: Targeted falsification/rollback/boundary checks for real changed behavior, not score targets or implementation-mirroring tests; consolidate with owner candidate package.
